name: Aaryan Singh
headline: Software Engineer | Product, AI Agents & Systems
summary: Built ReferRush from its first commit. Early engineer at extraordinary.com. Now building Rust agent infrastructure, with merged contributions to Atuin, Podman Desktop and 11 other repositories.

bullets: Built Shopify installation, WhatsApp referrals and UPI payouts from the first commit, including PAN and TDS handling. The platform reached 2,300 merchants, 30M+ customers and $1M+ processed.
Diagnosed a bank-reversal loop through payment-ID logs. Added a two-minute watchdog, EC2 worker recovery, alerts and payment isolation so other payouts could continue.
Worked directly with customers and closed brands through sales.
Built indexes, search and the customer directory powering onboarding for an O-1 visa platform.
Ran a freelance software agency alongside employment, building AI agents and full-stack products for clients.
Engineered email indexing, search and automation.

oss: Contributor to Atuin, Podman Desktop, WebTUI, Nimbus, iamb and eight other public repositories. 47 merged PRs, including 27 in termlens. Contributions span UI, runtime behavior, telemetry, performance and developer tooling.

projects.name: instantKV
projects.description: Built local-first agent memory in Rust: atomic topic/tag/time indexes, bounded BM25 search, revisioned writes and native OpenCode MCP. Measured 95.13% Recall@10 across all 500 LongMemEval-S questions with 14.34 MiB sampled server RAM on an M4 Pro.
projects.extra: Full LongMemEval-S answer accuracy: 85.20% with GPT-6 Luna as reader and judge, a model variant rather than official leaderboard parity. The memory engine needs no model or cloud calls. Source MVP; phone bindings and semantic search remain planned.
projects.pdfExtra: QA: 85.20% with GPT-6 Luna reader/judge (model variant). Source MVP; phone integration is planned.

projects.name: Morse
projects.description: Built remote execution that continues after client disconnects, streamed tool output, persisted sessions, event replay and crash recovery. A separate side agent reports progress without interrupting active work.
projects.extra: Verified session recovery after a container restart on a VPS.

projects.name: FireScope
projects.description: Built typed Functions/Firestore helpers, generated configuration and staged rebuilds. Verified HTTP, Hosting, callable functions and Firestore triggers in real emulators; added Node.js 22/24 CI.

projects.name: TiVM
projects.description: Built Linux desktop testing through accessibility, screenshots, video and reports. Added authenticated APIs, commit-pinned jobs, atomic queue claims, webhook deduplication and restart recovery.
projects.extra: Fixed host seccomp incompatibility blocking desktop startup.

projects.name: rushort
projects.description: Built a raw HTTP service with commit-before-ack writes, live backups and rollback. Measured 1.34M redirects/s on a four-vCPU VPS: loopback, pipeline depth 512, median of three eight-second runs, zero errors.
projects.extra: The same comparison measured 34,423 redirects/s without pipelining. These are controlled local measurements, not public HTTPS capacity.

projects.name: Rove
projects.description: Built streamed model/tool output, a live observer feed, bearer authentication and process-group timeouts; deployed verified commits through CI with rollback.
